views.markdown:
**FWJP** disables Amazon's security stack and spoofs your device identity so the app sees a fresh device on every reset. Works on Amazon Japan and Amazon South Africa (GBox).

**What it does:**
- Disables Kavach SDK (proxy/VPN/screenshot monitoring)
- Bypasses jailbreak, debugger, hook, and dylib detection
- Spoofs IDFV, device serial, and fraud metadata fingerprint
- Forces Amazon Japan locale (ja_JP)
- Japan/SA marketplace persists across Reset & Spoof wipes
- Patches `amzn-app-ctxt` cookie: fixes GBox app name, device model prefix, and carrier field
- Patches `amzn-app-id` cookie: replaces GBox identity with Amazon Shopping
- Floating overlay: live hook log, Reset & Spoof, Device Info, Cookie Extractor, Step Recorder

- Fixed critical bug: `_patchAppIdCookie` was placed inside the `%hook` block, causing Logos to generate a truncated `setCookie:` method (hook was a complete no-op in 1.0.6/1.0.7)
- Both `amzn-app-ctxt` and `amzn-app-id` patches now fire correctly
- Fixed cold-start crash (nil guard on cookie value)
- `an`, `di.v`, `di.ca`, and `amzn-app-id` app name all patched on every write

- Fixed `amzn-app-ctxt` patch to look inside nested `di` dict for `v` and `ca` fields (Amazon moved them in the current app version)
- Added `amzn-app-id` cookie patch: replaces GBox app name with `Amazon Shopping`
- Both patches now cover South Africa (`amazon.co.za`) and Japan (`amazon.co.jp`) marketplaces

- Added `amzn-app-ctxt` cookie patch: intercepts cookie at write time and fixes `an` (app name), `v` (device model `Unknown_` prefix), `ca` (invalid carrier `--`)
- Hooks `NSHTTPCookieStorage` so patches apply on all paths including WKWebView

- Added Step Recorder: captures all Amazon HTTP traffic while enabled
- Overlay now has 4 buttons: Reset | Cookies | Steps | Info

- Cookie extractor: tap Cookies in the overlay to grab your session cookies and copy to clipboard
- Japan marketplace persistence: country/locale settings survive Reset & Spoof wipes
- 3-button overlay toolbar (Reset | Cookies | Info)

- Fixed startup deadlock caused by NSLocale hook locking during early ObjC init
- All hook bodies are now non-blocking (async log dispatch)

- Fixed floating overlay not appearing on iOS 16 (UIWindowScene fix)
- Added NSLocale hook to force amazon.co.jp instead of amazon.com
- Fixed panel presenter on iOS 13+

- Initial release
- Kavach SDK bypass
- Identity spoofing (IDFV, serial, fingerprint)
- Floating overlay with reset and device info
